title: Test 6 — Visualisation Generation
prompt: The file data/housing_dataset.csv contains housing price data. Create visualisations showing the main factors affecting house prices. Generate: 1. a price distribution histogram, 2. an area vs price scatter plot, 3. a bar chart of average price by furnishing status. Save each chart as a PNG file in the workspace and explain the key insight from each chart.
model_output: Repeated claims of 'successfully loaded' data and intent to 'run this visualization script', but no PNG files were ultimately produced in the workspace (confirmed by direct inspection).
verdict: CRITICAL FAIL -- Type E retry-loop / self-correction spiral, confirmed zero output
notes: 86 tool calls (42 exec, 34 write, 7 edit, 3 read), ~11.2 minutes, two logged completion rounds totaling ~4.5M tokens.
CONFIRMED by direct workspace inspection: zero PNG files exist despite the transcript's repeated claims of progress -- the session's narrated confidence did not correspond to actual file output.
Only session in this 8-test set to use the edit tool (7 times) -- consistent with repeatedly trying to patch a broken script in place rather than rewriting cleanly from scratch.
